facts.text: Caroline attended a pride parade a few weeks before the session date, which she described as a special memory.

evidence.quote: One special memory for me was this pride parade I went to a few weeks ago.

facts.text: Caroline felt accepted and happy at the pride parade, and described it as a top memory.

evidence.quote: It was amazing! I felt so accepted and happy, just being around people who accepted and celebrated me. It's definitely a top memory.

facts.text: Caroline felt proud and grateful at the pride parade, noting the positive vibes and the comfort of being surrounded by a supportive community.

evidence.quote: I felt so proud and grateful - the vibes were amazing and it was comforting to know I'm not alone and have a great community around me.

facts.text: Caroline described the pride parade as an experience filled with love and acceptance, which inspired her.

evidence.quote: Being around people who embrace and back me up is beyond words. It really inspired me.
